## Prediction profiles and validation data points

`datapointL2()` ties a parameter `v` to the prediction by a [validation data point](methods-profiles.html#def-validation-data-point) of small
standard deviation; the [profile](methods-profiles.html#def-profile) of `v` is the prediction profile, and the values within the
$\chi^2_1$ threshold form the [confidence interval](methods-profiles.html#def-confidence-interval). `attrName = "data"` adds the validation term to
the [data term](methods-profiles.html#def-data-term), so `stop = "data"` and `confint(val.column = "data")` leave the [prior](methods-objective.html#prior) out
([Methods > Prediction profiles](methods-profiles.html#prediction-profiles)).

## Prediction band

```{r, echo = FALSE}
invisible(stored("results/reduced.rds", "refit.R"))
invisible(stored("results/prediction.rds", "prediction.R"))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# the decades of the prediction at the times of the band
band <- readRDS("results/prediction.rds")$band
decades <- log10(range(band$value[band$value > 0]))
```

`prediction.R` computes the profile at `r nrow(band)` times of the stimulated condition, from 2
minutes on; the results are loaded from `results/prediction.rds`. The prediction spans
`r inWords(floor(diff(decades)))` orders of magnitude, so the validation point has standard
deviation $0.01\,\hat v(t)$. The profiles run on linear scale, since the [resting state](methods-steady-states.html#stability) holds no
nuclear IκBα.

```{r predictionsetup, eval = FALSE}
```

```{r predictionprofiles, eval = FALSE}
```

```{r predictionband, eval = FALSE}
```

```{r}
saved <- readRDS("results/prediction.rds")
band <- saved$band
band[band$time %in% c(0, 10, 30, 55, 60, 70, 85, 90, 120, 240, 360), ]
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# the times at which a side of the profile ends below the threshold
short <- band$time[!vapply(saved$profiles, function(pr) {
  d <- as.data.frame(pr)
  min(d$data[c(1, nrow(d))]) - d$data[d$constraint == 0][1] > qchisq(0.95, 1)
}, logical(1))]
if (length(short))
  cat(sprintf(paste("At %s minutes one side ends before the threshold, and `confint()`",
                    "extrapolates the last part of the profile.\n"),
              paste(short, collapse = ", ")))
```

Profiles at three times, all in [All prediction profiles](#all-prediction-profiles):

```{r, fig.height = 3.5}
times <- c(10, 70, 240)
shown <- setNames(saved$profiles[match(times, band$time)], paste(times, "min"))
plotProfile(shown, mode == "data") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~proflist, scales = "free_x") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3), labels = function(x) signif(x, 2)) +
  ggplot2::guides(color = "none", x = ggplot2::guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.5, "lines")) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "nuclear IκBα [total NFκB]")
```

Band and prediction of the best fit:

```{r}
controls(gReduced, name = "attachInput") <- TRUE
bestReduced <- as.parvec(readRDS("results/reduced.rds")$fits)
out <- prdReduced(1:360, c(bestReduced, gaugeReduced), deriv = FALSE)$TNF
# the resting state holds no nuclear IκBα, which the log scale leaves out
course <- subset(data.frame(time = out[, "time"], value = out[, "nIkb"]), value > 0)
ggplot2::ggplot(course, ggplot2::aes(time, value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = band, ggplot2::aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                       inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = band, ggplot2::aes(y = lower), shape = 4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = band, ggplot2::aes(y = upper), shape = 4) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 360, 60)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "time [min]", y = "nuclear IκBα [total NFκB]") +
  theme_dMod2()
```

Units of total NFκB follow from the [gauge](methods-symmetries.html#gauge-and-reduction) of [Symmetries](guide-symmetries.html).

## All prediction profiles

In units of the prediction $\hat v(t)$ of the best fit:

```{r, fig.height = 16}
relative <- Map(function(pr, v) { pr$v <- pr$v / v; pr }, saved$profiles, band$value)
names(relative) <- paste(band$time, "min")
plotProfile(relative, mode == "data") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~factor(proflist, levels = names(relative)), ncol = 5, scales = "free_x") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = rep("black", length(relative)), guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::guides(x = ggplot2::guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "nuclear IκBα / prediction")
```

Reference: `datapointL2()`, `profile()`, `confint()`, `plotProfile()`
